mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, points_cost, price_amount, promo_status, promo_points, promo_amount, stock, image_url, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM point_product ORDER BY status DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, name, description, points_cost, price_amount, promo_status, promo_points, promo_amount, stock, image_url, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM point_product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, name, description, points_cost, price_amount, promo_status, promo_points, promo_amount, stock, image_url, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM point_product WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_product (name, description, points_cost, price_amount, promo_status, promo_points, promo_amount, stock, image_url, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{pointsCost}, #{priceAmount}, #{promoStatus}, #{promoPoints}, #{promoAmount}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE point_product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, points_cost = #{pointsCost}, price_amount = #{priceAmount}, promo_status = #{promoStatus}, promo_points = #{promoPoints}, promo_amount = #{promoAmount}, stock = #{stock}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE point_product SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND (stock = -1 OR stock > 0)
